what: Membership products on Gumroad support tiers that create varying levels of membership access with different content combinations, sell software with different license levels, and offer additional services on top of digital products such as coaching calls or community access.
verbatim_snippet: "Tiers are versions you can create within a membership. They can help you: Create varying levels of membership access, with each tier providing different combinations of content. Sell software with different license levels, like Individual or Team. Offer an additional service on top of your digital product, such as a coaching call or access to your community."
notes: Help center page requires sign-in for direct access. Snippet recovered via search engine index of the exact URL. Billing frequency names and free trial durations appear in separate non-continuous sections of the same page; those claims are handled in F-X02 and F-X03.
